rdfs:label: Service
rdfs:comment: An ActivityStreams actor representing a service — an automated, headless software offering.
notes: AS actor type for "a service of any kind" — typically non-interactive automated services (relays, search engines, archive bots); Mastodon also uses it for bot accounts. Distinct from `urn:solid:Application` (a software application, e.g. a client app). Both are direct subclasses of as:Object. The choice is descriptive, not enforced. Not schema:Service, which is a commercial offering rather than an actor. Not a sellable or offered service — for that use `https://schema.org/Service`.
